answer: The pigment counter is kept in echo and marble makes public each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 168 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
